findings.title: Two different nominal cold-screen readings are given for the same healthy and open-match cases (99.369 / 99.338 and 146.23 mV against 96.2 / 96.1 and 141.5 mV), with no stated basis
evidence: docs/ORDERING.md §8.3 bench bullet: 'Qualify healthy CONT/BUS ≈ 99.369/99.338 mV and open ≈ 146.23/0 mV'; docs/FMEA_REDUNDANCY.md line 9 and parts_qualification.md table (line 417–419) give the same, with the formula and 'Vf = 0.20 V' nominal.

docs/M3_R10.md 'Retained deviations' PYRO1_CONT_MID bullet: 'an open match then reads CONT / BUS 102.0 / 55.5 mV, against 96.2 / 96.1 mV healthy'; docs/R10_VALIDATION.md line 1923 ('healthy cold 96.2 / 96.1 mV') and §1 table line 2014 ('healthy cold 96.2 / 96.1 mV and open 141.5 / 0.0 mV').

Board (pcbnew, read-only): CONT bank R129 5.1k + R173 5.1k over R130 ∥ R178 2k, C127 10 nF; BUS bank R132 + R175 5.1k over R133 ∥ R180 2k, C129 10 nF; ratio 11.2. Recalculated with parts_qualification's formula: source 3.1 V (3.3 V − 0.20 V) gives 99.37 mV healthy / 146.2 mV open; 96.2 / 141.5 mV correspond to a 3.0 V source (Vf ≈ 0.30 V). Calculation.
findings.impact: The firmware developer writing the passive cold-screen bands (a ground hard-refusal, AGENTS §2.3) gets two nominal centres 3 % apart from four documents, without knowing which diode drop each assumes; the R19-SAF-04 bridge case (102.0 / 55.5 mV) is stated only against the 96.2 basis.
findings.concrete_fix: Text only: state one basis in parts_qualification.md (e.g. the nominal Vf = 0.20 V table and its band) and either restate the R19-SAF-04 bridge figures on that basis or label the 96.2 / 96.1 / 141.5 mV set as 'at Vf = 0.30 V' in M3_R10 and R10_VALIDATION.

findings.title: Firmware bring-up facts missing from M3_R10 'Firmware', pin_table.tsv and the binding note: barometer address, chip-select initial levels, sense scale factors, PA6 trip value, PA4 settling delay and USB VBUS sensing
evidence: Barometer: the only mention of U5's bus is pin_table row 96's loader column ('loader slave address 0b1001110x, not U5 0x76/0x77'). Board: U5.2 (PS) = 3V3A (I2C mode), U5.4 / U5.5 (CSB) = GND, U5.6 SDO via R64 10 kΩ to GND, U5.7 / U5.8 on I2C1_SDA / I2C1_SCL with R13 / R12 4.7 kΩ pull-ups. TE MS5611-01BA03 datasheet (cached .supervisor/r14_parts_pdf/te_ms5611.pdf; https://www.te.com/commerce/DocumentDelivery/DDEController?Action=srchrtrv&DocNm=MS5611-01BA03&DocType=Data+Sheet), I2C interface section ('address is 111011Cx, where C is the complementary value of the pin CSB') and pin table ('PS high (VDD) I2C'): CSB = GND gives 0x77. No doc states 0x77.

Chip selects: pin_table row 93 PB7 IMU_CS 'GPIO out', reset_contract 'as R7 (pass1/2/3_electrical, M3_R7 pin contract)'; board has R11 10 kΩ IMU_CS to 3V3 and R10 10 kΩ QSPI_NCS to 3V3. Row 81 SD_CS says 'initialise high before output mode'; IMU_CS does not. 25 pin_table rows defer to 'as R7'; docs/M3_R7.md 'Pin contract' (line 128 on) has no IMU_CS level or barometer address either.

Sense scales: board R60 100k / R61 10k (PA6 = VLOGIC / 11), R104 10k / R105 1k (PB1 = CAM_5V / 11), CONT / BUS banks / 11.2. M3_R10 'Firmware' gives none; PA6 / 11 appears only in ORDERING §8.3, PB1 only in the diagnostics sheet note (D-R22-03), / 11.2 only in parts_qualification.md.

PA6 watchdog: hold-up is computed 'to 3.8 V' (M3_R10 Firmware, binding note #12–13) but no document gives the ADC-watchdog trip voltage to program; M3_R10 Power line 488 'Still to qualify: the PA6 threshold'.
PA4: M3_R10 Firmware and binding note port_states.startup: 'Wait a settling delay after PA4 goes low' with no value or basis.

USB: pin_table row 68 PA9 = NC; PC8 VBUS_SENSE is a GPIO divider. Neither source says that OTG_FS hardware VBUS sensing (which on STM32H7 uses PA9) must stay disabled so the device enumerates with PA9 unconnected (Inference: RM0433 OTG_GCCFG not re-read here).
findings.impact: A firmware developer using only the three named sources must re-derive the barometer address from the board, may drive IMU_CS low at GPIO setup (no init level stated), has no scale factors for the power monitors, no starting PA6 threshold and no PA4 delay, and may enable OTG VBUS sensing on an unconnected PA9 so USB never enumerates.
findings.concrete_fix: Text only: add to M3_R10 'Firmware' (and the binding note's obligations) one 'Bring-up facts' bullet: U5 MS5611 on I2C1 PB8 / PB9 at 0x77 (PS high, CSB low), 4.7 kΩ pull-ups R12 / R13; IMU_CS (PB7, R11) and QSPI_NCS (PB6, R10) idle high, write ODR high before output / AF; scales PA6 = VLOGIC / 11, PB1 = CAM_5V / 11, PC0 / PC5 = node / 11.2; a provisional PA6 trip (owner / bench value) and PA4 settling time; OTG_FS VBUS sensing off (PA9 NC), USB presence from PC8 (Inference until RM0433 is read). Replace 'as R7' in pin_table reset_contract with the R10 pull resistor where one exists.

evidence: AGENTS.md table, STM32H743 row: 'DS12110 is cited as Rev 8 throughout.' docs/M3_R10.md 'Sources and datasheet revisions': Rev 8, with 'Two design limits read from Rev 11 … (the 6.0 V FT cap and the 4.0 V ADC-mode maximum)'.

findings.title: Hot-plug and ILM probe points are given at U9 pad centres under the QFN body
evidence: docs/ORDERING.md §8.3 probe worksheet: 'U9 IN5 /OUT6 | B(18.25,81.6) /B(18.75,81.6) | Simultaneous input/output hot-plug probing'; 'Probe U9 ILM only at its own pad'.

Board (pcbnew): U9 B.Fab body x 17.40–19.60, y 80.50–82.70. Pad 5 (BAT_IN) x 18.10–18.40, y 80.40–82.80; pad 6 (RAW_PROTECTED) x 18.60–18.90, y 80.40–82.80: each exposes only 0.10 mm × 0.30 mm beyond the body at each end. Pad 9 (BAT_ILIM) x 19.10–19.70: 0.10 mm exposed. The stated coordinates are under the package.

Reachable nodes on the same nets: C88.1 B(19.4,84.37) BAT_IN and C82.1 B(19.3,78.25) RAW_PROTECTED (already in the worksheet as 'local bypass nodes'), and R84.1 B(20.775,81.825) on BAT_ILIM (R84 750 Ω 0.1 %).
findings.impact: The bench operator is told to probe points that cannot be reached on an assembled board, or will try to probe a 0.1 mm sliver beside a QFN on the high-energy input; the hot-plug acceptance (IN ≥ max(−15 V, OUT − 21 V)) then has no defined measurement point.
findings.concrete_fix: Text only: replace the U9 row with 'U9 IN / OUT: at the exposed pad ends B(18.25,80.45) / B(18.75,80.45) with a fine probe, or at C88.1 / C82.1 (state the extra copper between)', and say 'probe ILM at R84.1 B(20.775,81.825)'.

findings.title: The per-flight checks differ between ORDERING 8.3, the vehicle handoff and AGENTS, and two of them use bottom-side parts that face the sled
evidence: ORDERING §8.3 per-flight / pre-flight items: (i) board off with J400 open and J121.2 < 0.1 V; (ii) 'PA6 and PA4 at pack power, before each flight (R22-POWER-02)'; (iii) J400 ESD handling (R22-REQUIREMENTS-03: 'Touch the airframe or pad ground before the switch…'); (iv) PORT_4V8 'first article and pre-flight' 4.71–4.87 V; (v) 'After coating and before each flight, powered NRST at C24.1 must be ≥0.90×3V3 measured at C15.1'.

docs/R10_VEHICLE_HANDOFF.md 'Power, arming and USB' carries (i) and (iv, before connecting a module) only; grep finds no 'ESD' and no 'PA6' in the handoff. AGENTS 'Pad arming access' row carries (i) only.

Board: C24 B(25.45,49.0), C15 B(29.05,47.4) and TP81 B(31,84.8) are on the bottom face, which ORDERING 8.4 puts on the nonconductive sled; item (v) has no installed-configuration method, and item (i)'s 'with access' rail readings use TP81 / C15.1 too.
findings.impact: The vehicle team, which works from the handoff, would not apply the J400 ESD handling rule or the PA6 / PA4 single-via screen before flight; the per-flight NRST gate cannot be done without unbolting the board, so it is either silently skipped or forces a sled removal each flight.
findings.concrete_fix: Text only: put one numbered per-flight list in ORDERING 8.3 and link it from the handoff and AGENTS' pad row; add the ESD handling sentence and the PA6 / PA4 log check to the handoff; state whether the NRST gate is per installation (board off the sled) rather than per flight, or name a reachable probe.

findings.title: ORDERING §8 does not restate the consignment procedure or several order-form values it relies on
evidence: ORDERING §8 opening: 'use their [§1–7] generic … procedures only where restated here'. The consignment mechanics (buy 7–10 attrition spares, consign in Parts Manager, select the consigned stock when JLC matches the BOM, and 'jlc_stock.py and therefore check_procurement.py have no consignment path: check a consigned quantity in Parts Manager by hand') are only in §1's R9 U4 bullet (line 34). §8.1 says only 'consign franchised … into JLC's parts inventory'.

Quantity: §8 gives '5 boards' only as the cost basis; no PCB or PCBA quantity, silkscreen colour or material / TG is stated for the forms (§8.1 PCB row gives layers, thickness, ENIG, green mask, copper and stackup).

C84: §8.1 row 'An owner purchase on the owner BOM'; stock_check.json shows C46550466 with JLC stock 111,344, but no doc says whether to buy it with the JLC order (parts-only) or elsewhere, or how many spares for the manual fit.
findings.impact: Following §8 alone, a newcomer consigning U4 / U9 would not know to buy attrition spares or to expect check_procurement to keep failing on a correctly consigned part, and must guess quantities on the forms.
findings.concrete_fix: Text only: restate in §8.1 the consignment steps (spares count, Parts Manager, BOM-match selection, the procurement tools' blind spot) and add a short form checklist: 5 PCBs / 5 PCBA, white silkscreen (if intended), FR-4 TG per the stackup, C84 bought as N + spares from JLC / LCSC with the order.
